prompt: This recursive method causes a StackOverflowError. Why?
choices: n - 1 is an invalid expression inside recursion
The method has no base case — it recurses infinitely without stopping
return type should be void for recursive methods
explanation: There is no base case. count(0) calls count(-1) calls count(-2) forever. Fix: add if (n <= 0) return 0; before the recursive call. Without a base case, the call stack fills and StackOverflowError is thrown.
